title: Linear forms in two logarithms and interpolation determinants II

consultation.scope: Publisher full text: introduction, hypotheses of Theorem 2, Corollaries 1-2 and Table 1.
consultation.remaining: No parameter optimization or comparison with the laboratory's specialized log(2), log(3) bounds was performed; full determinant proof not audited.

notes: Refines the LMN two-logarithm estimates. Corollary 2 requires positive real, multiplicatively independent algebraic numbers and admissible degree/height bounds. Its Table 1 includes C2=17.9 with m=30; the max term contains m/D, so selecting that constant alone is invalid. Candidate comparison source for Papers A/D, not evidence of an improved bound over Rhin or of escape from the recorded Diophantine obstruction.
